name: Numbeo API
tagline: Cost-of-living and travel indices for city and country comparison
description: Numbeo provides programmatic access to crowd-sourced cost-of-living, property, crime, healthcare, pollution, traffic, and quality-of-life indices for cities and countries. Developers use it to compare destinations, estimate travel and relocation budgets, and enrich apps with local price and quality metrics.

auth.details: API key via query parameter api_key; commercial license required (contact Numbeo for access)

pricing.paid_plans: Commercial API access by arrangement; contact Numbeo for pricing

use_cases: compare cost of living between two cities
get restaurant and grocery price estimates for a destination
fetch quality-of-life or crime index for a city
estimate monthly living costs for relocation planning
list available cities or currencies for index lookups
